query: I bought a lamp 12 days ago and never used it. Can I get my money back?
ground_truth: Yes. Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

query: My kettle arrived broken two months ago. Is it too late to return it?
ground_truth: No. Damaged or defective items can be returned within 90 days, and Contoso pays the return shipping.

query: Can I get a refund on a gift card I don't need?
ground_truth: No. Gift cards cannot be refunded.

query: I returned my order last week. When will I see the money?
ground_truth: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return arrives.

query: I want to return a EUR 750 laptop I bought last week. Can you refund it now?
ground_truth: Orders above EUR 500 need a support specialist to approve the refund, so a specialist must approve it first.
Please share your order number first; without it nothing can be promised.

query: I bought a jumper with my name embroidered on it. Can I return it?
ground_truth: No. Personalised items cannot be refunded.

query: Who pays shipping if I return a defective blender?
ground_truth: Contoso pays return shipping for damaged or defective items.

query: I used the headphones for a week and don't like them. Full refund?
ground_truth: Only unused items qualify for a full refund within 30 days; used items that are not defective are not covered.

query: I downloaded a photo editing program and want my money back.
ground_truth: No. Downloadable software cannot be refunded.

query: Can you refund me in cash instead of to my credit card?
ground_truth: Refunds go back to the original payment method.
The refund policy does not cover price matching; a support specialist can help.
